message: Donation crown stays heavy: **Chanco (114)** and **JaxikoLane (106)** are feeding the whole kingdom, with **Vijay (92)** right there keeping the pipes flowing. Ladder is stacked—**raquaza (12,341)** still runs *Magic Academy*, and **King Levy (11,532)** is holding the line up in *Summit of Heroes* with that **Witch + X-Bow** madness. War is live and we’ve got **Chanco** on the board already—if you’re able today, cash in your **4 decks** and turn movement into momentum.
